summary:
IMDb is the film and TV database at imdb.com. Its yellow “IMDb” tab icon is a frequent bookmark lookup, and the dimensions below were read from the downloaded file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against imdb.com. HTML came from https://www.imdb.com/ (HTTP 202). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. imdb.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.imdb.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 60×60 png.

Brand colour #222222 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-60x60-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-60x60-01.png at 60×60 (png, 1030 bytes) from https://www.imdb.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
